name: theme-provider
title: PdfcnThemeProvider
description: Provide a PdfcnTheme to all pdfcn components under the provider.
author: pdfcn-vue

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PdfcnTheme } from '@/lib/pdfcn/pdf-themes';
import { computed, provide } from 'vue';
import { professionalTheme } from '@/lib/pdfcn/themes/professional';
import { pdfcnThemeKey } from '@/lib/pdfcn/theme';

const props = defineProps<{
  theme?: PdfcnTheme | undefined;
}>();

provide(
  pdfcnThemeKey,
  computed(() => props.theme ?? professionalTheme),
);
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>
